Bun.Archive API creates & extracts tarballs

// Create an archive from filesconst archive = new Bun.Archive({  "hello.txt": "Hello, World!",  "data.json": JSON.stringify({ foo: "bar" }),  "binary.bin": new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]),});// Or get as Blob/Uint8Arrayconst blob = await archive.blob();const bytes = await archive.bytes();// Or read files:const files = await archive.files();const text = await archive.files("*.{txt,json}");// Extract an existing tarballconst tarball = new Bun.Archive(await Bun.file("package.tar.gz").bytes());const fileCount = await tarball.extract("./output-dir");console.log(\`Extracted \${fileCount} files\`);// Enable gzip compression (.tar.gz)const compressed = new Bun.Archive(files, { compress: "gzip" });// Gzip with custom compression level (1-12)const maxCompression = new Bun.Archive(files, { compress: "gzip", level: 12 });
// Write to local fileawait Bun.write("archive.tar", archive);await Bun.write("archive.tar.gz", compressed);
// Write to S3await Bun.write("s3://bucket/archive.tar.gz", compressed);await s3Client.write("archive.tar.gz", compressed);
